blue-marble.jpg and black-marble.jpg are NASA Earth Observatory imagery (Blue Marble Next Generation,
Reto Stockli, NASA Earth Observatory; Black Marble 2016, NASA Earth Observatory images by Joshua Stevens,
using Suomi NPP VIIRS data from Miguel Roman, NASA's Goddard Space Flight Center). NASA imagery is not
copyrighted and may be used freely; NASA asks to be credited as the source. See VERSION for the files'
origin and checksums.
